pages.notes: Mission narrative and operational details captured accurately; classification headers, strikethrough redactions, and FOIA exemption boxes heavily corrupted by OCR, affecting approximately 25% of text.

Mission report form with clear typewritten text and FOIA-redacted sections; OCR captures structure and most content accurately but struggles slightly with redaction box text and strikethrough headers (SECRET/NOFORN).
Form with FOIA exemption markings captures most field labels correctly, but misses the red strikethrough 'SECRET/NOFORN' classification header and loses formatting of redaction boxes.

Document is a military aircraft mission report form with clear, well-scanned original. OCR corrupts the SECRET/NOFORN header as 'tfflf!ltl'PifN81'8Nf' but accurately captures the mission timeline, timestamps, and redaction codes (1.4a, 1.4c, 1.4g); footer declassification text is rendered correctly.

Classified ISR mission report with multiple redacted sections (shown as black boxes); OCR severely garbled the SECRET//NOFORN header and mishandled redacted areas with tildes/strikethrough, though bulk narrative and unredacted structural text were mostly captured correctly.

Operational reconnaissance report with multiple redacted coordinate references. OCR captures main narrative text accurately but produces garbled character sequences (~lua], ~(@, <iLiil) where black redaction bars appear over grid coordinates and location codes, reducing overall fidelity.

Form with structured UAP reporting fields captured mostly correctly, but OCR struggled significantly with redacted/strikethrough portions (showing garbled characters instead of redaction marks) and boxed credential fields, producing errors like '~' for redacted sections and occasional character misreads (IYO vs IVO).
